sun.label: Sun Salutation entry
sun.summary: Arms up, fold, look up, jump back, Up Dog, Down Dog

steps.m: From Samasthitih, raise the arms overhead
Fold forward, hands beside the feet
Lift the head and lengthen the spine
Jump or step back to Chaturanga Dandasana

sun4.label: Sun Salutation entry
sun4.summary: Arms up, fold, look up, jump back to Chaturanga

steps.m: From Samasthitih, raise the arms overhead
Fold forward, hands beside the feet
Lift the head and lengthen the spine
Jump or step back to Chaturanga Dandasana

vinyasa.label: Vinyasa
vinyasa.summary: Lift up, jump back, Up Dog, Down Dog

steps.m: Cross the legs, press the hands down and lift up (Utpluthih)

vinyasa-bakasana.label: Vinyasa
vinyasa-bakasana.summary: Bakasana, jump back, Up Dog, Down Dog

steps.m: Bend the knees onto the upper arms in Bakasana

vinyasa-chakrasana.label: Vinyasa
vinyasa-chakrasana.summary: Chakrasana, Chaturanga, Up Dog, Down Dog

steps.m: Chakrasana: hands beside the ears, roll backward over the shoulders

back.label: Vinyasa
back.summary: Jump back, Up Dog, Down Dog

steps.m: Hands down, jump or step back to Chaturanga Dandasana
Hands under the shoulders, push up into Up Dog

close.label: Return to standing
close.after: Inhale, rise up; exhale to Samasthitih

steps.m: Jump forward between the hands, lift the head
